The '''Scarred Plains''' were the plains on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]] with a [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] reserve that was mined by the [[Abafar Extraction Conglomerate]] until it had run dry.<ref name="Eternal">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>
